name: Lead Generation & Outreach Team
purpose: Identify target accounts, score ICP qualification, draft personalized outreach, and prepare approval tickets.

roles.title: Account Researcher
responsibilities: Locate decision makers and company data

roles.title: Market Analyst
responsibilities: Score ICP fit and qualification triggers

delegation_rules: Researcher gathers leads -> Analyst qualifies -> Writer drafts -> PM creates Approval Ticket
review_process: Strict permission-slip ticket creation before any message dispatch
approval_requirements: Every single outbound email or message strictly requires L2 human approval ticket
final_deliverable: Qualified Prospect Dossier with drafted messages and pending approval tickets
